To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated the possibility of using arrays of organic transistors as sensors of mechanical variables and of bio/chemo-receptors.

(1) arrays of pressure sensors based organic field effect transducers can be assembled on plastic films; (2) the sensitivity to the pressure can be tuned by changing the gate voltage; (3) the sensitivity to bending can be enhanced by using a suitable substrate; (4) the device can be functionalized with a receptor for the detection of chemical species; (5) the device can detect pressure applied by people standing on a carpet.
arrays of OFETs can be used to detect mechanical stimuli and to monitor the deformation of planar surfaces.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and the characterization of new organic materials, the fabrication of organic devices and the realization of new applications.
the fabrication, characterization and application of organic field-effect transistors (FETs).
the development of new sensors based on organic semiconductors for mechanical and bio- and chemic detection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
organic field effect transitors are very promising devices for the development of a new generation of smart and flexible sensors.

the proposed devices have a high potential for application in the field of non invasive monitoring of people and objects, in a wide range of situations, from the home to the factory, from hospitals to the battlefield.
the OFETs are very promising for the realization of a wide range of sensors for different applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of organic field effect transitors as mechanical sensors is a promising approach for the development of a new generation of sensors for mechanical and bio-chemical variables.
arrays of OFETs can be employed to monitor the mechanical deformation of a planar surface and the pressure applied by a single person or a crowd of people.

the OFETs can be considered as a novel class of sensors with a wide spectrum of applications in the field ranging from the detection of mechanical stimuli, to bio-chemical sensing, up to the detection of the presence of people.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed sensors can be easily integrated in the environment and they are capable of detecting the presence and the movements of a human subject without any direct contact.
the OFET technology is a powerful platform for the fabrication of sensors with a high degree of flexibility and a low cost of production.
the OFETs can be used as mechanical sensors and that they can be easily integrated into arrays for detecting pressure and bending.
